name: Per-fragment Voxel-Cell Mask Injection
definition: A technique to inject a per-fragment Signed Distance Field (SDF) evaluation into a compiled fragment shader using THREE.Material.onBeforeCompile, producing clean cube-shaped carves without forking the underlying renderer.
summary: Per-fragment Voxel-Cell Mask Injection carves 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes by injecting per-fragment SDF evaluation into the shader, producing sharp cube edges without forking the renderer.
